articles.title: These Scientists Burned Their Own Scrolls — to Read Ancient Ones
articles.summary: Nearly 2,000 years ago, a volcano turned a Roman library's scrolls into blackened lumps. Now scientists burned their own scrolls on purpose to find a secret way to read the words inside without ever opening them.

articles.title: A Quantum Computer Made Matter 'Pop Into Existence' — Here's How
articles.summary: Scientists used a quantum computer to pull apart tiny particles until new ones suddenly popped into existence. It's one of the first times this weird physics trick has been shown in a lab.

articles.title: NASA's New Telescope Could See What Even James Webb Can't
articles.summary: NASA is designing a new space telescope called PRIMA that sees far-infrared light — wavelengths the James Webb telescope can't detect. If it launches in 2033, it could reveal how planets and galaxies are born.
